title: Valses nobles et sentimentales - Valse I (Modéré, très franc)
notable_excerpt: Key: G major. Chord journey: I - ii(+) - vi - ii - vi lilting opening, I7 tonicizes iii, VI-vi pivot shifts to minor, IV7 - ii7 - IV7 - I close. Texture: oom-pah waltz bass under busy eighth-note right-hand figuration.
video_use_ideas: Elegant, slightly off-kilter waltz colour for a film-score sketch.
legal_notes: US public domain only (composer died 1937; work published 1911, before 1931). Also public domain in the EU / life+70 countries (composer died 1937); only this pre-1931 publication is US-PD, later works by the composer are not. OCR draft: score made by optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) from the public-domain Durand 1912 print scan https://archive.org/details/imslp-nobles-et-sentimentales-ravel-maurice, then corrected (Claude Opus). Method: OMR from PD scan, corrected. Bar count matches the scan and every bar has the correct duration; estimated pitch accuracy ~90% from spot checks. MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES; slurs, pedal and most grace notes not encoded. Transcription by LaDoger's library, released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/ravel_m61_valses_nobles_1.musicxml. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
